title: Which fills first by the mnemonic?
statement:
Compare 4s and 3d using the n+ℓ filling mnemonic. Which is listed first?

[_]{a}

explanations: Its sum of four is below five.
Lower n alone does not win when the sums differ.

hints: The tie-breaker is only needed for equal sums.
solution: Compute 4+0 and 3+2. The lower sum comes first. The tie-breaker is only needed for equal sums. Its sum of four is below five.
